title: Finite coefficient model with compatible residue field
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative domain and $r\subset A[X]$ a nonzero prime with $r\cap A=0$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Let $L$ be a field equipped with a finite extension $\kappa(r)\to L$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Give $L$ its $A$-algebra structure through $A\to A[X]\to\kappa(r)\to L$. There exists an $A$-subalgebra $B\subset L$, finitely generated as an $A$-module, and a nonzero prime $s\subset B[X]$ with $s\cap B=0$, such that the canonical $B$-algebra $\kappa(s)$ is a fraction field of $B$ and there exists a $B$-algebra isomorphism $e:\kappa(s)\cong L$. For every $f\in A[X]$, $e$ sends the residue of its coefficientwise image in $B[X]$ to its image under $A[X]\to\kappa(r)\to L$. All types have the universe of $A$ and $L$.

proof.text: Localize A[X] at nonzero coefficients. The extension of r is a nonzero prime in K[X], hence maximal. Identify its residue field with kappa(r); reduction by its monic generator shows finiteness over K.
Choose a finite K-basis of L integral over A by clearing denominators (Mathlib FiniteDimensional.exists_is_basis_integral). Its generated subalgebra B is finite over A.

Clear denominators in coordinates to show L is the fraction field of B. Let s be the kernel of evaluation of B[X] at the image of X. Primality and zero contraction follow from the embedding in L; a nonzero polynomial in r stays nonzero in B[X] and belongs to s.

The embedded quotient B[X]/s contains B and has fraction field L. Uniqueness of fraction fields gives the B-algebra equivalence kappa(s) to L, compatible with evaluation on all polynomials. Transport the fraction-field structure back along this equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_coefficient_model (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hr : r ≠ ⊥) (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra r.ResidueField L] [Module.Finite r.ResidueField L] : letI : Algebra A L := ((algebraMap r.ResidueField L).comp ((algebraMap (Polynomial A) r.ResidueField).comp Polynomial.C)).toAlgebra ∃ B : Subalgebra A L, Module.Finite A B ∧ ∃ (s : Ideal (Polynomial B)) (hs : s.IsPrime), letI := hs s ≠ ⊥ ∧ s.comap (Polynomial.C : B →+* Polynomial B) = ⊥ ∧ IsFractionRing B s.ResidueField ∧ ∃ e : s.ResidueField ≃ₐ[B] L, ∀ f : Polynomial A, e (algebraMap (Polynomial B) s.ResidueField (Polynomial.map (algebraMap A B) f)) = algebraMap r.ResidueField L (algebraMap (Polynomial A) r.ResidueField f)
